description: This file 'files.inc.php' contains utility functions related to file handling, including generating unique filenames, extracting file extensions, reading file contents, and compressing/uncompressing files using gzip.

methods.name: getUniqueFileName
methods.description: Generates a unique filename with a given extension.

methods.name: getFileExtension
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a filename or returns a default if none found.

methods.name: getFileContents
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a specified file.

methods.name: gzip_compress_file
methods.description: Compresses a source file into a gzipped file.

methods.name: gzip_writeToFile
methods.description: Writes data to a gzip compressed file.

methods.name: gzip_uncompress_content
methods.description: Uncompresses gzipped content from a string and writes it to a temporary file.

methods.name: gzip_readFileContent
methods.description: Reads the uncompressed contents from a gzipped file.
